info.name: Trenching Bot — Solana Devnet RPC
info.description:
Every read-only Solana HTTP JSON-RPC method (50 of the 52 documented at https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http) against public devnet. Excluded on purpose: sendTransaction and requestAirdrop, which change chain state.

The MVP folder holds only the methods the live wallet adapter needs and runs on its own; set trackedAddress to the tracked wallet (default: devnet USDC mint so it works out of the box).

Run the whole collection in order: earlier requests save live inputs (slot, blockSlot, signature, tokenSignature, tokenAccount, tokenOwner, votePubkey, blockhash, feeMessage, unsignedTransaction) as collection variables for later ones. tokenMint defaults to Circle's devnet USDC.

The public endpoint blocks getTokenLargestAccounts, getLargestAccounts and getTokenAccountsByDelegate (429); against it those three report 'Blocked on public devnet'. Any other rpcUrl asserts them fully.

No wallet, credentials, signing or billing is involved. These calls go to devnet directly and do not exercise the application.

exec: pm.test("Blocked on public devnet (429): use a private RPC for a result", function () { pm.expect(body.error.code).to.equal(429); });
pm.test("Request id is preserved", function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.equal(sent.id); });

item.name: MVP
item.description: The read-only HTTP methods the live wallet adapter needs; self-contained, run it alone with `--folder MVP`. The live path also needs WebSocket logsSubscribe (wallet and pool mentions) and slotSubscribe, which a collection file cannot hold. The folders below are a full reference.

request.description:
Read-only `getVersion` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getversion

Connectivity check, as in SolanaDevnetLiveTest.
Read-only `getHealth` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/gethealth

Read-only `getSlot` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getslot

Current slot: lag tracking and deciding when slot +1/+2/+3 has passed.

exec: pm.test("Confirmed slot is a positive safe integer", function () { pm.expect(Number.isSafeInteger(result) && result > 0).to.equal(true); });

request.description:
Read-only `getSignaturesForAddress` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getsignaturesforaddress

Gap recovery and restart backfill: page with `before`/`until` from a saved cursor. Set trackedAddress to the tracked wallet (or a pool address for price backfill).

exec: pm.test("Has a successful transaction", function () { pm.expect(result.find(s => s.err === null)).to.not.equal(undefined); });

request.description:
Read-only `getTransaction` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/gettransaction

What the wallet normalizer reads: slot, block time, success, signer, and pre/post token balances (mint, owner, raw amount, decimals) to derive base/quote deltas. maxSupportedTransactionVersion is 1: devnet already carries version 1 transactions.

exec: pm.test("Has slot and block time", function () { pm.expect(Number.isSafeInteger(result.slot) && result.slot > 0).to.equal(true); pm.expect(result.blockTime).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test("Account keys carry signer flags", function () { pm.expect(result.transaction.message.accountKeys[0]).to.have.property('signer'); });

pm.test("Token balances carry mint, owner, raw amount and decimals", function () { const balances = result.meta.postTokenBalances; pm.expect(balances).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; const b = balances[0]; pm.expect(b.mint).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.owner).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.uiTokenAmount.amount).to.match(/^[0-9]+$/); pm.expect(b.uiTokenAmount.decimals).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test("Pre token balances present for deltas", function () { pm.expect(result.meta.preTokenBalances).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description:
Read-only `getAccountInfo` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getaccountinfo

Fallback for decimals and token-program identity when a transaction lacks them. getMultipleAccounts does the same for several mints in one call.

exec: pm.test("Owned by a token program", function () { pm.expect(['TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA', 'TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb']).to.include(result.value.owner); });

item.name: Transactions
item.description: Transaction lookups, fees and simulation. Saves tokenSignature, tokenAccount, tokenOwner and blockhash.

request.description:
Read-only `getSignaturesForAddress` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getsignaturesforaddress

Saves the newest successful transaction touching tokenMint as tokenSignature.

exec: pm.test("Has a successful token transaction", function () { pm.expect(result.find(s => s.err === null)).to.not.equal(undefined); });

request.description:
Read-only `getTransaction` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/gettransaction

Saves a token account holding tokenMint (tokenAccount) and its owner (tokenOwner) from the transaction's post token balances. maxSupportedTransactionVersion is 1: devnet already carries version 1 transactions.

exec: const holding = (result.meta.postTokenBalances || []).find(b => b.mint === mint && b.owner && b.uiTokenAmount.amount !== '0');
pm.test("Has a token balance for tokenMint", function () { pm.expect(holding).to.not.equal(undefined); });

request.description:
Read-only `getLatestBlockhash` against public Solana devnet. Docs: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getlatestblockhash

Also builds an unsigned message/transaction (fee payer only, no instructions) for getFeeForMessage and simulateTransaction.

exec: if (carry < 0) throw new Error('Invalid base58 character');
for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) { carry += bytes[i] * 58; bytes[i] = carry & 255; carry >>= 8; }
